jobs.description:
At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.

Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.

When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.

Project Manager (IT) at BairesDev

As a Project Manager (IT), you will oversee technology projects and guide technical teams to deliver successful IT solutions. This role provides an excellent opportunity to advance your management capabilities while collaborating with talented technical professionals in a dynamic environment.

What You'll Do:

- Direct project planning and coordinate team activities to meet delivery objectives.
- Mentor and support team members while maintaining effective communication.
- Track project performance and contribute to process improvements.
- Collaborate with clients and stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver value.
- Assist with budget planning and resource allocation for projects.

- Experience in team leadership, project management, or engineering roles.
- Good communication and interpersonal skills.
- Client-focused approach and positive attitude.
- Understanding of budget management and project planning.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
- Problem-solving mindset and willingness to learn.
- Technical background or IT industry knowledge.
- Advanced level of English.

How we do make your work (and your life) easier:

- 100% remote work (from anywhere).
- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred
- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.
- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.
- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.
- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.
- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.

Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

jobs.description:
FusionSoft, a division of Harris; is seeking a Project Manager who will be responsible for managing the customer relationship during implementations and ensuring a high degree of customer satisfaction.

They will collaborate with stakeholders and internal teams to deliver projects on schedule and within the budget while meeting scope requirements. They will possess excellent communication skills and proven problem-solving skills.

This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 50%. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean. Preference will be given to candidates who can work in PST timezone.

Salary

120K - 135K

AI & Innovation Mindset

We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

What Your Impact Will Be

Manage the scope of the project and changes to the project deliverables, while ensuring customer satisfaction and profitability.
Explain implications of changes to project scope and priorities to client and management to ensure changes are understood and approved.
Manage project financials.
Proactively resolve project issues to mitigate delays and reduce the impact on project timelines.
Provide updates to the management team and coworkers on customer/project status.

Travel

This person must be willing to travel as necessary.
The position is not anticipated to travel more than 30-50%.

What We Are Looking For

Education in Business Administration or related field.
Experience in managing software development projects through all phases of the project life cycle.
Understanding of software development processes and methodologies.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Proven leadership abilities and experience in leading cross-functional teams.
Excellent analytical skills to assess project progress and make data-driven decisions.
This position requires a senior level project manager who is adept at communicating with various levels of an organization.
This role must also be comfortable managing resources located throughout the world.

What We Can Offer

3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days
Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits starting from your first day of employment
Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs
Lifestyle rewards
Remote work and more!

FusionSoft serves the electric utility market and has a significant presence among the largest domestic providers. jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - BPO Transition
jobs.description:
En Servinform buscamos un/a Senior Project Manager con ADN BPO.

Si has liderado proyectos de implantación y transición de servicios de BPO, Contact Center o Backoffice
, esta oportunidad es para ti.

Somos una compañía sólida y en pleno crecimiento, con casi 50 años de experiencia en soluciones tecnológicas y de negocio. Contamos con más de 6.000 profesionales en España, Portugal, Italia y Colombia, prestando servicios a más de 1.500 clientes nacionales e internacionales.

En un momento clave de crecimiento, buscamos incorporar un/a Senior Project Manager
para liderar proyectos de transición e implantación de nuevos servicios BPO.

¿Qué buscamos?

No buscamos únicamente un/a Project Manager. Buscamos a una persona que conozca de primera mano el funcionamiento de un entorno BPO y que haya participado en la puesta en marcha de nuevos servicios, coordinando equipos multidisciplinares y gestionando proyectos complejos de principio a fin.

Es imprescindible aportar experiencia previa en empresas del sector BPO, Contact Center o Externalización de Servicios
, liderando proyectos de implantación, transición o transformación operativa.

Funciones principales

Liderar proyectos de implantación y transición de nuevos servicios de Contact Center y Backoffice.
Elaborar y gestionar el plan de proyecto, definiendo alcance, cronograma, hitos, recursos y presupuesto.
Coordinar equipos multidisciplinares implicados en la transición (Operaciones, RRHH, IT, Formación, Calidad, Legal, Compras, etc.).
Gestionar la relación con el cliente durante todas las fases del proyecto, actuando como interlocutor principal.
Identificar, evaluar y mitigar riesgos, estableciendo planes de contingencia cuando sea necesario.
Supervisar el cumplimiento de plazos, costes, calidad y objetivos establecidos.
Coordinar actividades de transferencia de conocimiento, formación y puesta en producción (Go Live).
Realizar el seguimiento de indicadores y elaborar reportes periódicos para Dirección y cliente.
Impulsar iniciativas de mejora continua, optimización de procesos y estandarización de metodologías dentro de la PMO.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Contrato a término indefinido en un proyecto estable, con oportunidades de crecimiento y desarrollo profesional dentro de una compañía líder en el sector.
Salario competitivo, acorde con la experiencia y los conocimientos aportados.
Excelente ambiente de trabajo y colaboración.
Jornada laboral de tiempo completo.
Modalidad de trabajo 100 % remota, con desplazamientos puntuales a las sedes de Grupo Servinform cuando el proyecto lo requiera.
Horario de lunes a jueves de 9:00 a. m. a 6:30 p. m. y los viernes de 9:00 a. m. a 3:00 p. m.
Ubicación de referencia: Lisboa, Portugal.

Si cuentas con experiencia liderando proyectos de implantación dentro del sector BPO o Contact Center y buscas asumir un rol estratégico con alto impacto en la organización, te ofrecemos la oportunidad de incorporarte a un entorno dinámico, innovador y en constante evolución.

**Ningún sector de nuestra sociedad puede ser entendido sin la igualdad entre hombres y mujeres, así como la integración de las personas con discapacidad. Por eso, en Grupo Servinform enfocamos la igualdad y diversidad como un factor elemental para el progreso social, trabajando día a día para cumplir este objetivo.**

Requisitos mínimos *Requisitos:

¿Qué perfil buscamos?
Formación universitaria, preferiblemente en Ingeniería, Administración de Empresas o similar.
Experiencia a partir de 5 años gestionando proyectos de implantación o transición en empresas del sector BPO, Contact Center o servicios.
Experiencia liderando proyectos complejos y coordinando equipos multidisciplinares (sin jerarquía directa)
Conocimiento del funcionamiento operativo de servicios de Contact Center y Backoffice.
Experiencia en planificación de proyectos, gestión de presupuestos, cronogramas y control de riesgos.
Capacidad para gestionar múltiples proyectos simultáneamente.
Excelente capacidad de comunicación, negociación e influencia.
Nivel de inglés C1.
Certificación PMP (PMI) o PRINCE2 Practitioner.
Certificación Scrum Master, Product Owner o metodologías Agile para despliegues flexibles.
Certificación Lean Six Sigma Green Belt o Black Belt (optimización de procesos operativos).
Metodologías Híbridas: Capacidad para combinar la planificación estructurada (Waterfall) con entregas iterativas y ágiles (Agile/Scrum).
Conocimiento de herramientas de gestión de proyectos como MS Project, Jira, Monday, Planner o similares.
Experiencia en proyectos de transformación digital, automatización de procesos o inteligencia artificial aplicada a operaciones.
Experiencia en gestión del cambio (Change Management).

About The Role

The Project Manager drives delivery across software engineering, product, design, security, and go-to-market teams. The role coordinates technical initiatives such as platform improvements, customer-facing product releases, cloud infrastructure migrations, and API or data integrations.

This role turns complex work into executable plans, maintains delivery visibility, and removes risks before they affect timelines or customers. Success means predictable launches, clear ownership, disciplined communication, and measurable progress across multiple concurrent initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Drive end-to-end delivery for technical projects, from scope definition and dependency mapping through launch and post-release review
Build and maintain project plans, milestones, RAID logs, and status reporting in Jira, Confluence, or comparable tools
Coordinate engineering, product, design, QA, security, and infrastructure teams across Agile or hybrid delivery processes
Translate technical requirements into clear workstreams, acceptance criteria, owners, and measurable deliverables
Track dependencies across APIs, cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, CI/CD workflows, and third-party integrations
Facilitate sprint planning, backlog reviews, release readiness reviews, and stakeholder updates
Identify schedule, scope, and delivery risks early; drive mitigation plans and escalate decisions with clear business context

What We Are Looking For

3-8 years of experience managing software, infrastructure, data, or technology implementation projects
Experience leading cross-functional delivery in a technology company, SaaS environment, or technical consulting organization
Working knowledge of software development lifecycles, Agile practices, Jira, Confluence, and release management workflows
Ability to understand technical discussions involving APIs, cloud platforms, databases, CI/CD, and system dependencies without requiring hands-on engineering ownership
Strong planning, prioritization, written communication, and stakeholder-management skills
Track record of delivering complex projects on schedule while managing changing requirements and competing priorities
Bonus: PMP, Scrum Master, or comparable certification; experience with AWS or Azure, Kubernetes, data platforms, enterprise integrations, or distributed engineering teams

Head of Project Management Office

As Senior Project Manager, you'll take ownership of the successful delivery of medium to large-scale, technically complex projects that help ABB's Energy Industries customers improve productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. You'll provide the leadership needed to deliver outstanding customer outcomes while balancing commercial performance, quality, safety, compliance, and operational excellence. Working collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams, you'll play a key role in upholding ABB's reputation for innovation, integrity, and world-class project delivery, while driving continuous improvement and creating lasting value for our customers and the business.

Our Team Dynamics

Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

What’s in it for you?

We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.

Your Role And Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll help run what runs the world, by taking on meaningful work that drives real impact.

Lead the successful delivery of complex projects from handover through to completion, taking ownership of planning, execution, and overall project performance.
Build, inspire, and develop high-performing project teams through coaching, mentoring, and creating an environment where people can thrive.
Drive projects to successful outcomes by managing scope, schedules, budgets, resources, and cash flow to achieve commercial and operational objectives.
Partner with customers, suppliers, and key stakeholders, becoming their trusted point of contact and ensuring exceptional communication throughout the project lifecycle.
Proactively identify, manage, and mitigate project risks while capitalising on opportunities to maximise value for both ABB and our customers. Ensure projects are delivered to the highest standards of quality, governance, and contractual compliance, applying industry best practices at every stage.
Collaborate closely with Supply Chain and commercial teams to procure services and materials, manage project changes, and support successful contract delivery.
Champion a culture of continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned and driving enhancements to project delivery methods and PMO standards.
Lead by example in promoting ABB's values, maintaining the highest standards of integrity, and ensuring compliance with our Code of Conduct and business processes.
Put safety first by fostering a strong Health, Safety and Environment culture, ensuring the wellbeing of employees, contractors, customers, and everyone involved in project delivery

Work model: hybrid {} from our St Neots location

Qualifications For The Role

Significant experience in project management.
Proven track record of managing full project lifecycle, including scope, schedule, cost control, and vendor/subcontractor management.
Strong collaborative and solution-oriented mindset, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated leadership capability, with experience managing teams and influencing stakeholders at all levels.
Advance Planning, Scheduling and Organisational skills. Relevant qualifications such as an engineering or technical degree, or a recognised project management certification.

Genuine interest in applying AI tools to improve compensation workflows and team productivity

Experience with equity administration platforms (e.g., Schwab EquiView or similar)

Experience working with large datasets using tools like BigQuery or SQL; familiarity with Python a plus

Responsibilities

About the Team
The Security and Information Technology team is missioned to run and operate security infrastructures, platforms and technologies, as well as to support cross-functional teams to protect our users, products and infrastructures. In this team you'll have a unique opportunity to have first-hand exposure to the strategy of the company in key security initiatives, especially in deploying and maintaining scalable and secure-by-design systems and solutions. Our challenges are not your regular day-to-day technical problems; you'll be part of a team that's developing new solutions to new challenges of a kind not previously addressed by big tech. It's working fast, at scale, and we're making a difference.

About the Role
The Senior Technical Program Manager, Operational Excellence will report to the Head of Security and Information Technology in USDS and will be a core member of the team that connects cross-functional business initiatives and creates the operating mechanisms, governance, and processes required for productivity, progress tracking, and efficiency. The team's primary goals are to actualize the Security and Privacy's strategic vision by executing business strategy with low security and privacy (S&P) risks, efficient cost structures, and within the parameters of U.S. compliance mandates.

The Senior Technical Program Manager, Operational Excellence will focus on meeting business and service expectations through continuous improvement of S&P operating rhythms, OKR and KPI development and tracking, and end-to-end program leadership. This leader will work with technical teams to develop tools and dashboards to track progress, surface risk, identify organizational weak spots, and drive remediation that improves efficiency, and execution quality. The Program Manager will develop a deep understanding of the entire S&P organization, independently lead essential cross-functional programs, and partner with senior leadership to translate strategy into measurable outcomes. The ideal candidate brings strong judgment, executive presence, entrepreneurial problem solving, and the ability to think both strategically and tactically to break down complex problems into scalable solutions.

Responsibilities
- Collaborate with the S&P senior leadership team to drive change management efforts by identifying areas for strategic change, leading large-scale transformation and efficiency programs, defining the overall transformation journey in collaboration with leadership, setting milestones, and determining success metrics.
- Build cohesive tooling and maintain dashboards unifying success/failure metrics for all of S&P.
- Collaborate with Chief Security Officer, Head of Security and Information Technology, and S&P leadership to provide data-backed insights and recommendations that drive strategic decisions and prioritization.
- Own the Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), executive program reviews, and related narratives from content formation through delivery to senior leadership and peers.
- Analyze and anticipate needs from compliance and operational standpoints, internal capabilities, and potential opportunities to provide data-backed insights that influence S&P strategic direction.
- Identify organizational and operational inefficiencies, uncover root causes and weak spots, and develop targeted remediation plans. This includes redesigning processes, optimizing systems, and leading cross-functional initiatives to drive measurable improvements in operational excellence.
- Develop and maintain key performance metrics, including KPIs and OKRs, to track the success of strategic and operational efforts. Regularly report progress to the Security Officer and other senior leaders, using data-driven insights to inform decisions, drive accountability, and help eliminate unnecessary or low-impact work.

Primary Responsibilities
- Project Management: Lead end-to-end execution of critical priorities. Examples:
- Replacement of Security and IT commercial tools with internal alternatives
- Drive cross-functional realignment of the operating model
- Driving towards meeting our Money Transmission Licensing (MTL) compliance requirements for both Security and IT.

- Business Operations & Reporting:
- Help translate organizational and company priorities into specific OKRs, key metrics, and execution plans.
- Organize S&P Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).
- Track, manage, and report on OKRs and quarterly performance metrics across the organization.
- Help prepare Board materials and internal presentations for leadership reviews and decision-making.

- Efficiency:
- S&P PMO will work with functional leads and XFN stakeholders to identify efficiency opportunities, translate to action plans and drive the delivery to unlock financial/personnel/time savings. Identify resourcing needs (FTE, TPA, BPO) for strategic initiatives while assessing impact to S&P financials

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of experience in technical program management, program management, or project management in security, infrastructure, enterprise technology, or similarly complex technical environments.
- Experience building programs from kick-off to close, specifically planning and leading large, cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and executive visibility.
- Demonstrated ability to operate independently, earn the trust of senior leaders, and influence organizations without direct authority along with demonstrated ability and comfort with data analysis for the purpose of storytelling, consensus-building, and executive decision support.

Customer Relations & Comment Management Program Manager Job Description:

HDR is seeking a Customer Relations & Comment Management Program Manager to establish and manage a public comment response and tracking program that supports infrastructure projects across North America. This individual will design, implement, and manage a scalable customer experience program that provides timely, accurate, and defensible responses to public inquiries, comments, and concerns received during project planning, permitting, construction, and operations.

The successful candidate will bring expertise in customer experience, contact center operations, stakeholder response management, or constituent services and will apply those skills to support transportation, energy, water, environmental, and community infrastructure projects. They will develop response protocols, governance frameworks, quality assurance programs, CRM workflows, reporting systems, and staffing models while working directly with a network of project coordinators and subject matter experts.

This role will partner closely with HDR’s Strategic Communications professionals, project managers, technical experts, and clients for consistent, transparent, and risk-aware public engagement across a diverse portfolio of projects.

Key Responsibilities:

Program Development & Leadership
Build and lead HDR's Public Comment Response Program.
Develop standard operating procedures (e.g. sensitive issues, media inquiries, and regulatory comment periods), response protocols, and quality assurance processes.
Create governance structures supporting consistent responses across projects and geographies.
Build a scalable program capable of supporting multiple concurrent infrastructure projects.
Train communications specialists to use and assist in maintaining CRM databases.
Develop onboarding, training, and quality control programs.
Foster a culture focused on customer service excellence and continuous improvement.
Other duties as assigned.

Comment Management Operations:

Design workflows for managing inquiries and comments received through websites, contact forms, email, surveys, interactive maps, public meetings, open houses, and regulatory comment periods.
Develop escalation pathways for sensitive, technical, legal, political, or high-profile issues.
Create response templates, knowledge libraries, and decision trees.
Monitor response quality, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness.

Technology & Systems:

Evaluate, administer, and optimize CRM and comment management platforms.
Improve existing Zoho-based processes and recommend alternative technologies where appropriate.
Develop dashboards and reporting tools that provide project teams and clients with actionable insights.
Evaluate opportunities to use AI and automation while maintaining quality and accountability.

Strategic Communications Support:

Partner with project managers and communications teams to support project engagement goals.
Advise project teams on stakeholder concerns, emerging issues, and response strategies.
Participate in proposal development and client presentations.

Preferred Qualifications:

10 years of experience in leading customer service operations, customer experience management, contact center leadership, constituent services, stakeholder response programs, or a related field.
Experience building operational programs from concept to implementation.
Demonstrated success managing teams and service delivery performance.
Experience implementing CRM systems, workflow automation, or customer service technologies.
Experience with Zoho CRM.
Strong understanding of quality assurance, escalation management, and process improvement.
Experience supporting highly visible, regulated, or politically sensitive initiatives preferred.
Knowledge management skills to build response libraries, approved language banks, FAQ repositories, AI-assisted drafting tools, etc.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in related field
A minimum of 5 years related experience
Efficient use of the internet and other electronic and hard copy media for research
Strong Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Project and Visio skills
Expert Microsoft Access and Excel skills
Strong analytical skills with the ability to compile and present summary level information
Ability to obtain, cleanse, merge and analyze data from multiple sources
Excellent interpersonal skills and strong relationship, organizational and follow-up skills
Self-starter with proven track record of accomplishments
An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must

What We Believe

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Our Commitment

As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.

Your Role at Tessy

Manage customer relationships and customer teams throughout project/program.

jobs.title: Technical Infrastructure Program Manager, Data Center Controls
jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS is seeking an exceptional individual to join the Data Center Capacity Delivery (DCCD) Controls team as a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM). Controls TIPMs are responsible for planning, executing, and delivering programs that support the Controls Deployment and Service (CDS) organization, including Controls information technology (IT) infrastructure, deployment, service, data center capital improvement, and colocation work. These programs drive operational efficiency and innovation, while ensuring CDS is maintaining the highest level of safety and security standards. TIPMs take on large, ambiguous problems within CDS, identify and develop solutions, and lead their implementation and adoption. Ongoing support includes owning program communication, records, and reporting; proactively identifying and remediating risks and vulnerabilities to program operations; and tracking compliance with organizational changes.

Key job responsibilities

Writing narratives that define program requirements and desired end-states to gain buy-in and approval from Controls leadership.
Developing program documentation, including statements of work, responsibility matrices, functional and design specifications, implementation approach, metrics, and reporting.
Owning and managing program communications, including delivering program status reports, metrics reports, and business reviews. Serve as the first point of contact for programs.
Developing program milestones and plans, securing resources and assigning responsibilities, and driving schedules to ensure timely and successful program delivery.
Accelerating program progress by driving crisp and timely decisions, mitigating risks, clearing blockers, and escalating appropriately.
Applying process improvement methodologies to drive efficiency in procedures and tools, including defining and clarifying business procedures and process requirements.
Managing post-launch support plans, including managing workflows, issues, tickets, Correction of Errors (COEs), and post-mortems. Developing mechanisms to automate or eliminate post-launch support as necessary.
Working directly with technical managers, engineers, and partner teams to set program priorities, secure resources, execute work, and drive delivery.
Support and manage the roadmap for a program, including yearly projects and organizational goals.

About The Team

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of technical infrastructure management experience
Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)
3+ years of experience managing projects/programs across cross-functional teams

jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS is seeking an exceptional individual to join the Data Center Capacity Delivery (DCCD) Controls team as a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM). Controls TIPMs are responsible for planning, executing, and delivering programs that support the Controls Deployment and Service (CDS) organization, including Controls information technology (IT) infrastructure, deployment, service, data center capital improvement, and colocation work. These programs drive operational efficiency and innovation, while ensuring CDS is maintaining the highest level of safety and security standards. TIPMs take on large, ambiguous problems within CDS, identify and develop solutions, and lead their implementation and adoption. Ongoing support includes owning program communication, records, and reporting; proactively identifying and remediating risks and vulnerabilities to program operations; and tracking compliance with organizational changes.

Key job responsibilities

Writing narratives that define program requirements and desired end-states to gain buy-in and approval from Controls leadership.
Developing program documentation, including statements of work, responsibility matrices, functional and design specifications, implementation approach, metrics, and reporting.
Owning and managing program communications, including delivering program status reports, metrics reports, and business reviews. Serve as the first point of contact for programs.
Developing program milestones and plans, securing resources and assigning responsibilities, and driving schedules to ensure timely and successful program delivery.
Accelerating program progress by driving crisp and timely decisions, mitigating risks, clearing blockers, and escalating appropriately.

Managing post-launch support plans, including managing workflows, issues, tickets, Correction of Errors (COEs), and post-mortems. Developing mechanisms to automate or eliminate post-launch support as necessary.
Working directly with technical managers, engineers, and partner teams to set program priorities, secure resources, execute work, and drive delivery.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. The opportunity

QBE Europe is recruiting for an experienced Program Manager to lead a significant multi-year Claims Transformation Programme.

This role will be responsible for the delivery of the Claims Cloud Transformation Programme, a multi-year initiative that will migrate our UK and European Claims operations onto a new Cloud platform. The programme will modernise our claims ecosystem, simplify technology landscapes, improve operational efficiency, enhance customer outcomes and establish the foundation for future cloud-enabled claims capabilities.

Reporting to the Head of Change Delivery, Claims & Operations, the successful candidate will be accountable for establishing, maintaining and driving delivery of the end-to-end programme roadmap across a 5+ year delivery horizon. The role will lead multiple workstream leads, delivery partners, technology suppliers and business stakeholders to achieve agreed business outcomes while ensuring alignment with enterprise, regional and global strategic objectives.

This is a highly visible leadership role requiring exceptional programme management, communication and stakeholder engagement skills. The successful candidate will create clarity and alignment across a complex delivery landscape by developing compelling plans, executive-level communications, delivery reporting and options analyses that enable timely and effective decision-making. At QBE, we get to the heart of what matters for our customers. And we do it all with a human touch.   

We’re an international insurer with more than 13,000 people working across 26 countries – which means we’re big enough for your ambitions, yet small enough for you to make a real impact. It’s an exciting time. We’re building momentum towards our vision to become the most consistent and innovative risk partner.  

What if you could have a positive impact – at work and in the world? As part of the QBE team, you’ll get to spend every day working with people who are passionate, talented and kind.

Facilitate alignment between cross- region / division/ supplier teams.

Ensure external partners remain aligned to programme objectives, timelines and quality expectations.
Manage commercial delivery performance, commitments and outcomes.
Build collaborative relationships across internal and external delivery teams.

Governance, Risk & Decision Making

Provide transparent reporting on programme health, milestones, risks, issues and financial performance.
Drive timely decisions through effective escalation and executive engagement.
Lead risk and dependency management across business and technology domains.
Ensure compliance with QBE change governance, technology standards and regulatory requirements.

Define, track and report programme benefits.
Ensure business readiness, adoption and value realisation remain central to delivery planning.
Support the transition to sustainable operational support models and cloud-based ways of working.

Having the right to work in the UK is a requirement for this role.  QBE may consider sponsorship at its discretion.

jobs.title: Autonomy Program Manager
jobs.description:
Riverside Research is an independent National Security Nonprofit dedicated to research and development in the national interest. We provide high-end technical services, research and development, and prototype solutions to some of the country’s most challenging technical problems.

All Riverside Research opportunities require U.S. Citizenship.

Position Overview

Riverside Research is seeking a Program Manager with a strong background in one or more of the areas of military operational experience, program management, autonomous systems engineering, and/or startups with a curiosity to learn the other areas. They combine that expertise and curiosity with an urgency to solve real problems for the warfighter and the humility to embrace any necessary task to support our Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) customer.

DIU is a Department of War (DoW) organization focused on accelerating the Department’s adoption of commercial technology at speed and scale. As the Department's gateway to leading technology companies, DIU is focused on rapid prototyping, fielding, and scaling of solutions that can save lives, increase performance, lower costs, and deter future conflict.

Driven by a sense of service and the desire to solve priority warfighter problems quickly, DIU Autonomy PMs enjoy unparalleled freedom with performance expectations to match.

A DIU Autonomy PM may work on autonomous system programs across domains, functions, and mission areas.

This position can be located in Mountain View, CA or Arlington, VA.

Responsibilities

Champion the needs of the warfighter first and foremost throughout program development and execution.

Drive program execution over the entire program lifecycle, from initial problem definition through solution design , operational testing, and final transition to the warfighter. Empowered to make critical decisions to ensure the program stays on schedule and within budget while addressing the defined problem . Responsible for the development of strategies, operating plans, and budgets .

Curate new programs through proactive engagement with DoW customers and outreach to companies to gain insights into DoW capability gaps and align them with potential commercial solutions that support DoW stakeholders.

Build and lead cross-functional i ntegrated p roduct t eams composed of civilians, military personnel, and contractors from within DIU and across the Department to enable program success. Responsible for gathering key stakeholders, assigning tasks, setting priorities, and driving timely decisions .

Serve as an Autonomy Subject Matter Expert (SME), continually building and sharing technical expertise on autonomous systems with team members and senior leadership.

C o llaborate with Acquisition professionals and other Program Managers to address contract-related matters.

Ensure accountability and rigor by establishing Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), monitoring program health through rigorous data analysis, and reporting outcomes directly to senior leadership. Authorized to re-baseline schedules, re-scope priorities, and take decisive corrective action to mitigate risks and resolve programmatic issues. Act as a critical member of the Autonomy team by leveraging expertise and resources across the team and by providing support and mentorship back to others working on other programs

Qualifications

Typically a minimum of 12 years of related experience with a bachelor’s degree, 8 years with a master’s degree, a PhD with 5 years’ experience, or equivalent experience is typically required for an employee at this level.

Required Experience

Demonstrated experience in program management (preferably in DoD acquisition, technology transition, or rapid prototyping).
Familiarity with autonomous systems engineering - enough to ask the right questions and assess vendor claims.
Experience writing SOWs, building schedules, issuing task orders, or managing similar project documentation.
Ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders and keep complex projects on track.
Mix of DoD/USG and commercial experience strongly preferred.
Current TS/SCI clearance required

ATTRIBUTES

Energetic & Mission-Driven – motivated to solve hard DoD problems with commercial technology.
Entrepreneurial – seeks opportunities, builds networks, and grows DIU’s impact.
Independent – makes informed decisions and keeps projects moving without constant guidance.
Agile & Flexible – navigates DoD bureaucracy and finds ways to get to “yes.”
Organized & Detail-Oriented – comfortable with the mundane PM tasks that make projects successful.
Fixer/Solver – proactively identifies risks, mitigates issues, and clears blockers.

NICE-TO-HAVES

Experience trying to sell technology to DoD or working inside a PEO/PM office.
Frustration with DoD bureaucracy and a passion to improve it.
Prior operational or combat experience (reinforcing end-user empathy).

jobs.title: Annotation Program Manager – AI/ML Data Operations
jobs.description:
About shift

shift pays everyday workers to record short videos of the tasks they already do (in kitchens,
workshops, job sites, bakeries, and warehouses) to help train the next generation of AI and
robotics. We’ve paid out over $15M to 25,000+ workers across 15+ countries.

About the role

We're looking for someone to own the quality bar for shift's egocentric training data - not to work to a
spec, but to write it. You'll own the golden sets, SOPs, and calibration system that every
annotator, reviewer, and auto-labeling model is measured against, and you'll work directly with
engineering to stand up new annotation workflows in hand tracking, object identification, and
action labelling. As we scale from thousands of contributors to millions, you're the reason the
99% accuracy bar holds. Your ground truth becomes the benchmark, and the model is
measured against it.

What you'll own

Own the quality bar end-to-end: golden/benchmark sets, acceptance criteria, frame-level tolerance thresholds, and the audit loops that hold them
Author, version, and continuously sharpen annotation SOPs, rubrics, and edge-case rules as the client spec evolves
Design and run inter-annotator agreement measurement (kappa/alpha, tolerance-based agreement on temporal boundaries) and publish regular quality reports
Analyse disagreement patterns to root cause - guideline ambiguity vs. annotator error - and fix the system, not just the file
Stand up the training and certification pipeline that brings new annotators and reviewers to the bar fast: onboarding, structured calibration sessions, targeted retraining
Design human-in-the-loop workflows where models pre-label and humans review, correct, and escalate - so output grows faster than headcount
Partner with engineering and product on new workflows: hand tracking (keypoints, left/right attribution, contact states), object identification (boxes/masks, ontology, naming consistency), action labelling (controlled vocabulary, segment boundaries)
Specify label schemas, annotation-tool requirements, and QC dashboards; validate pilot batches before production scaling
Run capacity planning across competing demands and allocate reviewer attention to the highest-impact work
Track acceptance/rejection, rework, and quality-adjusted productivity - and drive them week over week
Improve cost-per-accepted hour while protecting the bar; inform the in-house vs. vendor mix with quality data

What we're looking for

8+ years in AI/ML data annotation operations, including 4+ years managing annotation programs and teams (annotators, QA leads, managers)
5+ years of hands-on video annotation, including 1+ years with egocentric/first-person video for robotics or embodied AI - ideally at or for a leading robotics company or project

Strong analytical skills with Excel/Google Sheets for quality reporting
Data-driven, process-oriented mindset with strong ownership; startup-ready - comfortable with ambiguity, zero-to-one builds, and contributing when it matters most
Working understanding of ML and why annotation quality drives model performance

Experience managing distributed/global annotator workforces or external vendors

jobs.title: Project Manager - Global Payroll Transformation
jobs.description:
About Us

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

About GSS

As the internal support organization for DNV and DNV owned companies, we deliver shared services within Human Resources, Finance, IT and Real Estate & Procurement to DNV globally. Our mission is to enable DNV to grow, succeed with its business goals and improve competitiveness. Customer experience is at the core of everything we do. GSS is responsible for many of the tools, processes and daily routines that create the backbone of DNV.

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead the next phase of global payroll transformation within HR Global Shared Service (GSS). This is a two-year assignment focused on implementing a common global payroll solution, transitioning to a global managed payroll model and establishing a more standardized and scalable payroll setup.

You will take end-to-end ownership of project delivery. Working closely with Payroll Operations across GSS payroll teams in Europe, Asia and Americas, GSS Process Experts, Finance, Global Process Owners, IT and external Payroll vendors, you will be responsible for keeping the project on track, managing risks and ensuring successful delivery across all countries. We are looking for someone with practical experience in global payroll and payroll vendor implementations to navigate complexity and drive results.

Your Key Responsibilities

Lead the end-to-end global payroll transformation roadmap, from planning and country readiness through implementation, stabilization and handover to operations.
Drive implementation of the global payroll vendor solution across countries.
Coordinate delivery across HR Operations, Payroll Operations, Process Experts, Global Process Owners, IT, Finance, Procurement and external vendors.
Ensure global standards are implemented while meeting local payroll, compliance and statutory requirements.
Manage project plans, risks, budgets, governance and leadership reporting.
Lead stakeholder engagement, communication and change management activities.
Support successful testing, go-live, stabilization and handover to operations.
Drive continuous improvement, standardization and operational excellence across payroll services.

What we offer

What We Offer

Flexible work arrangements that help employees maintain a healthy balance between professional and personal life while staying productive.
Paid leave including annual, sick, compassionate, public holidays, marriage, maternity, and paternity leave.
Health and wellness benefits with medical insurance and annual health check-ups.
Financial security through pension plans and insurance coverage (life, accident, and travel).
Learning and development via training programs, sponsorships, and on-the-job learning.

Benefits may vary depending on role, employment type, tenure, location or grade level.

DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.

About You

About you

Significant experience leading global payroll transformation, payroll vendor implementation or payroll outsourcing programs across multiple countries.
Hands-on experience working with global payroll vendors and managed payroll service providers, including implementation and vendor governance.
Strong knowledge of end-to-end payroll operations, service delivery, controls, compliance, data flows and the interdependencies between HR, Payroll, Finance and IT.
Experience with complex country deployments, including planning, requirements, data migration, testing, cutover, go-live and stabilization.
Proven ability to lead global, cross-functional teams and influence senior stakeholders.
Strong project governance, commercial awareness, risk management and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a customer-centric mindset and cultural awareness.
Proficiency in advanced project management tools and software. Project or program management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2 or IPMA is an advantage.

Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.

jobs.title: Information Security Program Manager (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
The Role – What You’ll Do

Barr is seeking an experienced information security program manager to join our Minneapolis, Minnesota, team. In this hybrid role, you will lead Barr’s information security program and work cross-functionally across teams, focusing on continuous improvement as the security threat environment evolves. This is a hands-on role and reports to the director of information systems.

A successful person in this role is an analytical problem-solver with exceptional attention to detail and a passion for continuous learning. They are highly organized and leverage their technical expertise to implement robust security measures that safeguard system integrity and reliability. They also dig deep when needed, maintaining a broad strategic perspective on the business. The ideal candidate has a high degree of self-initiative, proactively leading security improvement and governance efforts, and enjoys collaborating with technical and non-technical colleagues, always with a client-service mindset.

Your Impact – Key Responsibilities

Security program administration and maintenance: oversee and continuously improve Barr’s information security program. Ensure that security measures are integrated across systems and that protective controls support the company’s needs for performance, stability, and high availability.
Cybersecurity subject matter expert: provide insight into developing and executing the company’s security strategy. Stay current on emerging threat intelligence and cybersecurity trends, and advise the organization on mitigating new threats.
Security governance and compliance: develop and maintain information security policies, standards, and procedures to ensure alignment with industry best practices and frameworks such as the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, and NIST SP 800-171.
Crisis management: plan, prepare for, and respond to security incidents or breaches, helping to coordinate containment, investigation, and recovery efforts to minimize damage and downtime. Support the company’s Crisis Response Team in planning and response activities that relate to or rely on technology.
Security monitoring and optimization: continuously monitor the IT environment for signs of security issues or vulnerabilities using appropriate tools and resources.
Escalation-level technical support: serve as the first escalation point for potential security incidents.
Vulnerability and patch management: lead proactive vulnerability management by conducting regular security scans and ensuring that processes and automated systems for the timely application of patches and/or upgrades are effective.
Documentation and training: develop and maintain internal security documentation and provide technical training and guidance for IT staff and end users on security best practices.
Audit support: maintain required documentation, perform internal security testing, and coordinate responses to audit findings or external audit requests.
Security assessments: respond to external security questionnaires, assessment tools, and client security surveys.
Program metrics and continuous improvement: track key security program metrics and use these insights to drive ongoing program improvements.

About The Opportunity

Hybrid: a hybrid work arrangement may be considered for this position. A hybrid work arrangement refers to splitting time worked between a Barr office and a home office. This position is based out of Barr's Minneapolis, Minnesota, office.
Travel requirement: ability to travel to other offices and sites across the US and Canada if necessary.

About You – Required Core Competencies

Education: bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field or equivalent practical experience.
Experience: 10+ years of related IT infrastructure or information security experience.
Working knowledge of corporate network environments and technologies such as VMware virtualization, Microsoft Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy management.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, or Amazon Web Services (AWS) administration and support.
Experience working with SIEM/SOC tools, including follow-up investigations and response.
Familiarity with scripting and automation tools (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Ansible) for system administration or security automation.

Willingness and ability to perform off-hours administrative changes and respond to emergencies or urgent issues outside of regular hours if needed.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship by Barr, now or in the future.

Helpful Additional Experience (not Required)

Recognized security certifications demonstrating expertise and commitment to the field.
Experience supporting external audits and compliance assessments (such as SOC2 audits, ISO 27001 certification processes, NIST 800-series compliance, or CMMC).

Compensation
: Anticipated range of $125,000-$150,000 annually. Compensation will vary based on relevant experience, education, skill level, and other compensable factors. Employees in this position may also be eligible for a discretionary cash bonus based on team and individual performance. This position is classified as exempt (salaried) under the Fair Labor Standards Act.

Benefits - What We Offer

We are committed to providing an employee experience that attracts and retains top talent. That's why we offer a competitive package of employee benefits - including some unique offerings not found at other companies. At Barr, we also believe that learning doesn't stop when you get your degree, which is why we provide coaching, mentoring, and support for ongoing educational opportunities to foster professional development at every stage of your career.

Competitive, affordable insurance plans: Medical, dental, vision, life, disability, accidental death insurance, and flexible spending accounts for medical and dependent care
Retirement benefits: 401(k) retirement savings plan with company contribution and an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) with company contribution in Barr stock
Profit distribution: Barr has a "no retained earnings" model and distributes all profit to our employees through our annual bonus distribution plan, ESOP, and dividends to shareholders
Professional development benefits: Annual time and expense allowances, mentorship program, and many internal training opportunities
Work/life balance: Paid time off, holidays, overtime for non-exempt/hourly staff, and compensatory time for exempt/salaried staff (time off or pay for extra time worked), paid family leave
Wellness focus: Ergonomic analysis and equipment, Personal Protective Equipment allowance, wellbeing-focused educational opportunities

Please note that benefits eligibility is determined and may change based on part-time, reduced-time, or full-time status.

About Us - Why Choose Barr

At Barr, you'll join a community of engineers, scientists, and professionals who will help you achieve your ambitions and build a meaningful, rewarding career. You'll serve as a trusted advisor to clients who value Barr's tailored solutions and commitment to exceptional service.

As part of our employee-owned firm, you'll contribute to a culture of commitment and camaraderie where staff can thrive as professionals. We value diverse perspectives and experiences and believe an inclusive workplace is critical to our success.

To learn more about Barr's culture and values, visit: https://www.barr.com/Careers/Our-culture

Open positions at Barr Engineering Co. do not have application deadlines. Barr Engineering Co. is an equal opportunity employer, and all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.title: Security Program Manager, AWS DC Security
jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS DC Security is looking for a Security Program Manager (SPM) to join our team. This is a partially hands-on role responsible for physical security hardware across data centers and support facilities in the Thames Valley region — from design and installation through to maintenance and compliance.

The Role

You will be an individual contributor on a team of three SPMs, working directly with Data Center Security Managers (DCSMs), Data Center Operations teams, and internal and external stakeholders.

You will oversee the design, deployment, and maintenance of physical security systems including Access Control, Intrusion Detection, CCTV, and Passive and Active Barriers. This covers new data centers, expansions, support facilities, and special security programs — all consistent with AWS security standards.

You will work with limited guidance. You will lead projects, develop solutions, author security design documentation and contracts, and manage vendor relationships to ensure industry-leading systems are deployed and maintained.

Who You Are

You have a deep understanding of electronic and physical security systems. You use that expertise to make the right decisions for security projects and site sustainment. You tackle complex security problems and compliance requirements — clearing blockers and escalating when needed.

You are comfortable identifying risks, asking the right questions to the right teams, and recommending solutions that balance security requirements against operational constraints. You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, written and verbal, and you drive discussions to decisions.

Key job responsibilities

Manage the physical security design and system installation lifecycle for new facilities, expansions, and special projects.
Provide project management including bid packages, specifications, drawings, code compliance, budget, vendor management, change orders, and close-out documentation.
Coordinate fault tickets and maintenance tasks with a team of vendor engineers, ensuring security devices are properly maintained.
Own and track high value security project budgets. Manage spend, budget variance, and cost reduction targets.
Lead system testing, acceptance, sign-off, and operational readiness validation for high-security facilities, in conjunction with other AWS teams.
Report performance metrics including vendor service delivery, costs, fault repair rates, and security program analysis.
Collaborate across teams to drive global, regional, and local security initiatives. Provide physical security analysis and recommend program enhancements.

This role involves approximately 50% daytime travel within the Thames Valley region.

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

You will need to be a UK national and able to obtain and maintain a UK Government Security Clearance. Further details found here: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels

Basic Qualifications

Experience working on physical security design and implementation of Access Control/Intrusion Detection and CCTV Surveillance systems
Experience overseeing security operations and working with security vendors/contractors
Experience as a general contractor and in vendor management (request for proposals, bidding, change orders, quality control, RFI/submittal tracking) associated with construction and project execution
Experience reading and interpreting construction drawings and specifications, or experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
Full UK driving licence.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in data centers or critical infrastructure
Knowledge of one or more of the following domains: access-control system and methodology, network security, application- and system-development security, security architecture and models, cryptography, and operations security
Experience in application security architecture, security code reviews, security testing, incident response, or security infrastructure
CISSP, CISA, CISM or other security certification
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, or experience in project management

jobs.title: Principal Technology Compliance Program Manager - Payment Card Industry - Data Security Specification (PCI DSS)
jobs.description:
Company
Alaska Airlines

The Team

Guided by our purpose, core values, and leadership principles, we are creating an airline people love. Our corporate teams set the strategies and operational plans to ensure the success of our company. Whether we use our expertise in accounting, human resources, finance, planning, legal, marketing, or any of our operational divisions, our shared passion for travel and our guests is what motivates us to achieve excellence each day. If you share our passion for creating an airline people love, we want to hear from you.

Role Summary

The Technology Compliance Program Manager (PCI) serves as the primary subject matter expert for the enterprise PCI DSS compliance program. This role is responsible for driving PCI strategy, governance, compliance assessments, audit readiness, and cross-functional remediation efforts to ensure the organization maintains compliance with PCI DSS requirements while reducing security and regulatory risk.

Key Duties

The Technology, Innovation and Customer Experience team (TICX) are responsible for technical and operational delivery for the attendees at our events with a focus on our registration systems, event apps and onsite delivery including access to the event.

As a team, we are a global group of high-performance event specialists who work collectively to successfully deliver events ranging from 300 to over 100,000 attendees across all regions of the world.

The Event Registration/Technology Project Manager will report to the Head of Technology, Events and will hold a pivotal position supporting our existing teams in the full life cycle of our events from pre-event planning to onsite delivery.

The successful candidate will work closely with the existing team as well as be the main point of contact across the business for their assigned projects/workstreams.

Coordinate and schedule project meetings

Dimensioning of onsite services

Onsite scanning both perimeter and sessions
Onsite staff including training
Risk & contingency planning

Documents for the digital onboarding of our customers into our platforms

Provide analytical support through reporting and data insights
Budgeting for areas of assigned responsibility
Contribution to roadmap and planning meetings

Demonstrable experience in event registration with technical and operational responsibilities
International event, conference or tradeshow experience as an organiser
Experience configuring and delivering event technology including registration systems, virtual event platforms, event apps such as Cvent, RainFocus, Stova or other SaaS platforms etc.

Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain complex processes to non-event or technical colleagues.
Supplier management experience
Awareness of data privacy, GDPR and information security principles

Stakeholder Management – builds trust quickly and keeps people aligned when priorities compete; comfortable holding the middle ground between internal teams and suppliers, surfacing issues early and handling disagreement with diplomacy so delivery keeps moving.
Project Management – brings structure to ambiguity and runs several workstreams at once without losing the thread; anticipates dependencies and risks and holds others to their commitments without straining the relationship.
Communication – clear and credible communicator, able to explain complex registration processes and technical concepts to non-technical and non-event colleagues.
Delivery – takes ownership and sees things through to completion; keeps a close eye on detail under pressure and makes sure nothing slips as an event approaches.
Analysis – reasons from evidence and is happy to sit with the data until it tells a story; turns numbers into decisions - what's working, what isn't, what to change - rather than reporting for its own sake.

Working at the GSMA offers you unparalleled access to the mobile industry. We offer a chance to truly shape the direction of mobile, whatever your role. By joining the GSMA, you will be exposed to a fast-paced rapidly evolving environment, working on global solutions, genuinely fascinating and industry-changing projects and a stimulating and dynamic environment designed to enable you to flourish.

Stronger together

We lean on each other so the industry can lean on us, embracing our diversity by actively seeking out perspectives and skill sets beyond our own, fuelling each other’s successes and constantly asking how we can help.

Underpinning our values is our collective mindset to show up purposefully as good human beings every day, in every situation. When we’re at our best – we are collaborative, considerate and compassionate to others, and we create a safe space for one another to thrive, assuming positive intent in our colleagues. Headquartered in San Mateo, California with more than 4,000 employees worldwide, the Rakuten International business portfolio includes market leaders in e-commerce, digital marketing, advertising, communications and entertainment. We create products and services that provide exceptional value by aligning members and the businesses that want to engage them in a shared community.

Rakuten is the most rewarding way to shop, giving millions of members Cash Back when they buy from their favorite brands. As a leading shopping platform, Rakuten partners with thousands of top brands across apparel, beauty and wellness, grocery, travel, on-demand services, subscriptions, and dining, helping members save on everyday purchases. Since 1999, Rakuten members have earned more than $4.6 billion in Cash Back, making it the largest Cash Back platform of its kind. Learn more at Rakuten.com.

Job Summary:

This role operates at the enterprise level and reports to the Chief of Staff to the CEO. The position partners closely with senior leaders across the organization to strengthen how the company plans, decides, and executes. The focus is on translating strategy into effective operating mechanisms, improving decision quality and follow-through, and creating visibility across priorities, tradeoffs, and outcomes.

This is not a people leadership, program management, or functional ownership role. Instead, the role enables leaders to operate more effectively at scale through influence, structure, and clarity.

Key Responsibilities:

Translate annual and multi-year strategic priorities into clear operating plans, milestones, and review cadences that connect leadership intent to measurable outcomes.
Structure executive and leadership discussions, including OKR and priority-setting forums, to surface tradeoffs, drive decisions, and ensure commitments are documented and followed through.
Own and continuously improve the company’s enterprise operating rhythm, including executive planning sessions, leadership offsites, All Hands, and quarterly and annual business reviews.
Maintain enterprise-level visibility into critical initiatives, dependencies, risks, and outcomes, surfacing issues early and aligning leaders on mitigation and course correction.

The job

Program Strategy & Leadership
:

Drive clarity across people, process, and technology dimensions of large-scale initiatives.

Governance & Operating Model:
